summary: EDAP TMS filed an 8-K to report the full exercise of the underwriters' 30-day greenshoe option in connection with its August 14, 2026 public offering of 8,425,000 ADSs at $4.75 per ADS. The additional 1,263,750 ADSs are expected to close on August 19, 2026, generating net proceeds of about $5.6 million. This routine offering follow-up is not a special situation; it involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative event. The filing confirms the ordinary capital raise mechanics and includes a legal opinion from Jones Day.
